anyOf.description: A finite value, written as a JSON number.
A non-finite value, written as its sentinel string.

NonFiniteF64Wire.description:
An `f64` in the [`non_finite_f64`] wire form: a JSON number when finite,
otherwise one of the strings `"inf"`, `"-inf"` or `"nan"`.

Contract types store plain `f64` fields with
`#[serde(with = "finstack_quant_core::wire::non_finite_f64")]` and name this
type in `#[schemars(with = ...)]`, so the generated schema describes the
sentinel strings the serializer actually writes.

NonFiniteSentinel.description: Sentinel string the [`non_finite_f64`] adapter writes for a non-finite `f64`.

avg_loss.description: Conditional negative-return mean, retaining its negative sign; undefined when absent.

avg_return.description: Arithmetic mean over all occupied bucket returns; undefined when empty.

avg_win.description: Conditional positive-return mean; undefined when no positive bucket exists.

best.description: Largest bucket return, or undefined for no buckets.

consecutive_losses.description: Longest strictly negative run among successive occupied buckets; observed zero interrupts it.

consecutive_wins.description: Longest strictly positive run among successive occupied buckets; missing buckets do not interrupt it.

cpc_index.description: Cardinal Profitability Construct adaptation `profit_factor * win_rate * payoff_ratio`; requires both groups.

kelly_risk_fraction.description: Signed loss-normalized binary risk fraction `p - q/payoff`, with decisive-bucket probabilities; requires both groups.

losses.description: Number of strictly negative bucket returns.

n_obs.description: Number of occupied aggregation buckets, including neutral returns.

payoff_ratio.description: Conditional mean gain divided by mean loss magnitude; undefined unless both groups exist.

profit_factor.description: Sum of gains divided by loss magnitudes; positive infinity for gains without losses.

win_rate.description: Positive bucket count divided by all occupied buckets; undefined when empty.

wins.description: Number of strictly positive bucket returns.

worst.description: Smallest bucket return, or undefined for no buckets.
